symbols_note: fixed list chosen before results: BTC, ETH and eleven large liquid alts; SOL/XRP/SUI/LINK/HYPE series end 2026-04-30 in the frozen set

5.line: EMA120 of completed 15m closes, first-close seed per contiguous run, ready after 1200 contiguous bars (V13.1 f_m15Ema120)

15.line: SMA60 of completed 1h closes, ready after 60 contiguous bars (V13.1 f_h1Sma60)

line_timing: a chart bar inside HTF bucket B reads the line of HTF bar B-1 (V13.1 knownAverage[1] with lookahead_on); missing B-1 -> no line

atr.trigger: line -/+ k * Wilder ATR14 of the same completed HTF bar as the line

pctl.trigger: long line*(1+Q_q(low/line-1)), short line*(1+Q_{1-q}(high/line-1)) over the completed chart bars of the previous 30 days (half the window required); the quantile must lie beyond the line

entry: path = 5m bars for both charts; the trigger is constant inside a chart bar; a long fills at min(open, trigger) of the first 5m bar whose low reaches it (short mirrored) - a resting limit at the trigger
excursion: one entry per excursion; an excursion starts at the first touch and ends at the first chart-bar close back within half the trigger distance of the line (close >= line - D/2 for longs); no line ends it; entries need no open position on that side (sides are separate books) and skip an excursion that starts while a trade is open

vix_fix.long: CM_Williams_Vix_Fix on the chart timeframe evaluated at the fill price: HH = max(prior 21 chart closes, P), wvf = (HH-P)/HH*100, bands from the prior 19 (sma/population stdev) and 49 (rangeHigh) completed wvf plus the current one; on when wvf >= upper or wvf >= 0.85*max
vix_fix.short: mirror, not part of the original indicator (unconfirmed): wvfT = (P-LL)/LL*100 with LL = min(prior 21 closes, P)
vix_fix.entry: inside the excursion, the first 5m bar (low reaches the trigger) where the filter is on at min(open, trigger), else at the highest price between that and the bar low where it turns on (bisection, the filter is monotone in price); an excursion where it never turns on is not traded

exit_path: 5m high/low; entry bar: stop if its low (short: high) reaches the stop, else target if its close is beyond the target; later bars: a gap through the stop or target fills at the open, stop first when both print in one bar; after 576 bars (48h) exit at that close; a missing bar before the exit drops the trade

controls.pool: same symbol, chart timeframe and calendar month, 5m bars with a ready line, HTF ATR / price within 0.5-2x the trade's
controls.entry: open of the pool bar, same side, same stop fraction, same R target, cap and cost

selection: per chart x side x vix_fix x re-entry arm, the cell (distance measure x level x stop x target) with the highest t of mean excess (net minus control) among cells with >= 30 select-period trades; its check-period numbers are the read
pass_bar: check period: mean net > 0 and mean excess > 0 with month-block sign-flip p < 0.01 (p < 0.05 = worth forward observation only)
reentry_rule: arm 0 = v1 (one entry per excursion); arm 3 = after a stop, re-enter at the first 5m bar after the exit bar whose low (short: high) reaches the trigger again inside the same excursion, at most 3 re-entries; Vix Fix arms apply the same gate to each re-entry; the excursion end is unchanged (price only)
